def transform(grid):

    C=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r); bg=C.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bands=[('h',r,grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1]
    bands += [('v',c,grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    if not bands:return a
    typ,k,b=min(bands,key=lambda z:C[z[2]])
    best=[]
    for x in range(10):
        if x==bg or x==b:continue
        S={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==x}
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
            for p in S:
                q=p;s=[]
                while q in S:s.append(q);q=(q[0]+dr,q[1]+dc)
                if len(s)>len(best):best=s
    if len(best)<2:return a
    n=min(best,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-k) if typ=='h' else abs(p[1]-k)); z=best[-1] if n==best[0] else best[0]
    dr=1 if z[0]>n[0] else -1;dc=1 if z[1]>n[1] else -1
    vr,vc=n[0]-dr,n[1]-dc
    if not(0<=vr<h and 0<=vc<w and grid[vr][vc]==bg):vr,vc=n
